content: Human-labeling session — perception-count-the-threat:hard seed 1. Objective: Five hidden enemy units are spread across both halves of the map under fog. Two enemy buildings (an ore silo and a turret) sit on the map but they are NOT units and must NOT be counted. The cluster arrangement rotates per seed — memorising "always scout north-east" misses two or three of the five on the south-heavy seed. Split the two jeeps across both lanes, read the count, build EXACTLY five rifle infantry. A sixth busts the over-commit fail; stopping at four misses the spec. Within about 45 turns.
